decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of part two-storey, part single storey rear extension, erection of side and rear roof extension incorporating two front roof windows; internal alterations and conversion of garage to store, bike store and utility room to the existing house, as shown on drawing numbers 465/P01, 465/P02, 465/P03 & 465/P04, Received 22 September 2006; and 465/P06 (Rev B), 465/P07 (Rev C), 465/P08 (Rev C) & 465/P09 (Rev C), received 22 November 2006 is recommended for approval as by reason of its size, position and appearance, it would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Grove Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope and have a 'conservation style' with a central mullion
description: Erection of part two storey part single storey rear extension, erection of side and rear roof extension incorporating two front roof windows; internal alterations and conversion of garage to store, bike store and utility room to the existing house.
